name: inline-edit
title: Inline edit
description: Text that turns into an input on click or Enter, with the same size and position so nothing jumps. Enter saves and Escape cancels; a save that returns a promise shows a small Saving spinner, then a check, and a failed save reopens the input with its message. Comes as a large title or a label and value row.
